clauses.label: joint continuity
clauses.literal_UTF8:
Continuous (fun a : (E × E) × ℝ × (E × E) =>
      Φ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧

clauses.label: joint measurability
clauses.literal_UTF8:
Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × ℝ × (E × E) =>
      Φ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧

clauses.label: time zero
clauses.literal_UTF8: (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, Φ y xRef 0 z = z) ∧

clauses.label: composition s after t
clauses.literal_UTF8:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ s t : ℝ, ∀ z : E × E,
      Φ y xRef (s + t) z = Φ y xRef s (Φ y xRef t z)) ∧

clauses.label: two-sided inverse
clauses.literal_UTF8:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ z : E × E,
      Φ y xRef (-t) (Φ y xRef t z) = z ∧
      Φ y xRef t (Φ y xRef (-t) z) = z) ∧

clauses.label: both actual ODE derivatives
clauses.literal_UTF8:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ z : E × E,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (Φ y xRef s z).1)
        (Real.sqrt η • (Φ y xRef t z).2) t ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (Φ y xRef s z).2)
        (-(Real.sqrt η)⁻¹ • ((Φ y xRef t z).1 - y) -
          Real.sqrt η • gradient V xRef) t) ∧

clauses.label: energy nonnegative
clauses.literal_UTF8: (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, 0 ≤ H y xRef z) ∧

clauses.label: energy invariant
clauses.literal_UTF8:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ z : E × E,
      H y xRef (Φ y xRef t z) = H y xRef z) ∧

clauses.label: pi endpoint
clauses.literal_UTF8:
(∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E,
      Φ y xRef Real.pi z = ((2 : ℝ) • c y xRef - z.1, -z.2))
